newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes 16 cents up on sellers' reserve.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes 16 cents up on sellers' reserve.

text.p: Tin prices closed 16 cents higher at 14.64 ringgit ($5.79) a kg amid merchants' year-end covering and a lack of sellers, traders said.

"Despite the closure of the London market, local prices jumped on a lack of sellers and merchants buying from locals and Europe," a trader said, adding that activity was confined to book-squaring ahead of the New Year holidays.

Turnover was 70 tonnes, unchanged from Thursday. The market is expected to remain around current levels or firm above 15 ringgit in near-term. The local price differential to London was $175 a tonne premium against $110 previously.
